```{ojs}
//| output: false

// 👉 NHỚ ĐIỀN MẬT KHẨU THẬT VÀO ĐÂY
secret_pass = "Swaper@234" 

async function fetchAndDecrypt(filename) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("../dashboard/" + filename);
    if (!res.ok) return []; 
    const encryptedBuf = await res.arrayBuffer();
    const keyBuf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(secret_pass));
    const keyBytes = new Uint8Array(keyBuf);
    const dataBytes = new Uint8Array(encryptedBuf);
    for (let i = 0; i < dataBytes.length; i++) dataBytes[i] = dataBytes[i] ^ keyBytes[i % keyBytes.length];
    return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(dataBytes));
  } catch(e) { return []; }
}

data_sxh = fetchAndDecrypt("sxh.dat")
data_threshold = fetchAndDecrypt("threshold.dat")
data_transmission = fetchAndDecrypt("transmission.dat")
data_severity = fetchAndDecrypt("severity.dat")
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
//| echo: false

// 👉 2. TÍNH TOÁN DATA CHUNG & LỌC ĐIỂM NÓNG
d3 = require("d3")

sys_max_yr = data_sxh.length > 0 ? d3.max(data_sxh, d => d.Year) : new Date().getFullYear();
sys_max_wk = data_sxh.length > 0 ? d3.max(data_sxh.filter(d => d.Year == sys_max_yr), d => d.Week) : 0;

getSmartVal = (dataList, wk, algoName) => {
  const rows = dataList.filter(d => Number(d.Week) === wk);
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  const row = rows[0];
  if (row[algoName] !== undefined) return row[algoName];
  if (row[algoName.toLowerCase()] !== undefined) return row[algoName.toLowerCase()];
  const matchRow = rows.find(r => r.Type === algoName);
  return matchRow ? matchRow.Threshold : null;
};

function countThresholds(disease, ward, yr, wk) {
  let w_data = data_threshold.filter(d => d.Disease === disease && d.NoiOHienTai_SauKhiSapNhap_WardId === ward && d.Year === yr);
  let row = w_data.find(d => d.Week === wk);
  if (!row) return 0;
  let cases = row.cases || 0;
  let far = getSmartVal(w_data, wk, 'Farrington') || 99999;
  let cus = getSmartVal(w_data, wk, 'Cusum') || 99999;
  let cdc = getSmartVal(w_data, wk, 'CDC') || 99999;
  let score = 0;
  if (cases > far) score++;
  if (cases > cus) score++;
  if (cases > cdc) score++;
  return score;
}

// LOGIC MỚI: PHÂN LOẠI ĐIỂM NÓNG (ĐỎ & VÀNG) VÀ LẤY SỐ CA ĐỂ SẮP XẾP
function getDetailedHotspots(disease) {
  if(data_threshold.length === 0) return [];
  let wards = [...new Set(data_threshold.filter(d => d.Disease === disease && d.NoiOHienTai_SauKhiSapNhap_WardId !== "Toàn Thành phố").map(d => d.NoiOHienTai_SauKhiSapNhap_WardId))];
  let results = [];

  for(let w of wards) {
     let s0 = countThresholds(disease, w, sys_max_yr, sys_max_wk);
     let s1 = countThresholds(disease, w, sys_max_yr, sys_max_wk - 1);
     let s2 = countThresholds(disease, w, sys_max_yr, sys_max_wk - 2);

     if (s0 >= 2 && s1 >= 2 && s2 >= 2) {
         // Lấy số ca tuần hiện tại để xếp hạng
         let w_data = data_threshold.filter(d => d.Disease === disease && d.NoiOHienTai_SauKhiSapNhap_WardId === w && d.Year === sys_max_yr);
         let row = w_data.find(d => d.Week === sys_max_wk);
         let cases = row ? (row.cases || 0) : 0;

         if (s0 === 3 && s1 === 3 && s2 === 3) {
             results.push({ name: w.replace("Phường ", "P.").replace("Xã ", "X."), type: 3, cases: cases, color: '#e74c3c' }); // ĐỎ
         } else {
             results.push({ name: w.replace("Phường ", "P.").replace("Xã ", "X."), type: 2, cases: cases, color: '#f39c12' }); // VÀNG CAM
         }
     }
  }

  // Sắp xếp: Ưu tiên Đỏ (type 3) lên trước, sau đó xếp theo số ca từ cao xuống thấp
  results.sort((a, b) => {
     if (b.type !== a.type) return b.type - a.type;
     return b.cases - a.cases;
  });

  return results;
}

function getCityKPI(raw_data, disease) {
  if(raw_data.length === 0) return { current: 0, trend: "---", status: {t: "KHÔNG CÓ DỮ LIỆU", c: "#999"} };
  let current = d3.sum(raw_data.filter(d => d.Year === sys_max_yr && d.Week === sys_max_wk), d => d.SoCa) || 0;
  let prev = d3.sum(raw_data.filter(d => d.Year === sys_max_yr && d.Week === sys_max_wk - 1), d => d.SoCa) || 0;
  let pct = prev > 0 ? ((current - prev) / prev * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
  let trend = current >= prev ? `▲ tăng ${pct}%` : `▼ giảm ${Math.abs(pct)}%`;
  let score = countThresholds(disease, "Toàn Thành phố", sys_max_yr, sys_max_wk);
  let status = score === 0 ? {t: "🟢 BÌNH THƯỜNG", c: "#2ecc71"} :
               score === 1 ? {t: "🟡 LƯU Ý", c: "#ffc107"} :
               score === 2 ? {t: "🟠 CẢNH BÁO", c: "#fd7e14"} : {t: "🔴 BÁO ĐỘNG", c: "#e74c3c"};
  return { current, trend, status };
}

kpi_sxh = getCityKPI(data_sxh, "Sốt xuất huyết");
hotspots_sxh = getDetailedHotspots("Sốt xuất huyết");
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// 👉 3. GAUGE ĐÁNH GIÁ MỨC ĐỘ LÂY TRUYỀN (5 MỨC)
trans_gauge = {
  let val = kpi_sxh.current;
  let thr = data_transmission.find(d => d.Disease === "Sốt xuất huyết") || {Seasonal: 100, Moderate: 200, High: 300, Extra: 400};

  let level = 1; let levelText = "RẤT THẤP"; let textColor = "#2ecc71"; // Xanh lá

  if (val > thr.Extra) { level = 5; levelText = "RẤT CAO"; textColor = "#9b59b6"; } // Tím
  else if (val > thr.High) { level = 4; levelText = "CAO"; textColor = "#e74c3c"; } // Đỏ
  else if (val > thr.Moderate) { level = 3; levelText = "VỪA"; textColor = "#fd7e14"; } // Cam
  else if (val > thr.Seasonal) { level = 2; levelText = "THẤP"; textColor = "#ffc107"; } // Vàng

  let angle = (level - 3) * 36;

  return html`
    <div style="width: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative;">
      <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #005d88; margin-bottom: 25px;">Đánh giá mức độ lây truyền</div>
      <div style="position: relative; width: 260px; height: 130px; overflow: hidden;">
        <div style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 260px; height: 260px; border-radius: 50%;
          background: conic-gradient(from 270deg, 
            #2ecc71 0deg 34deg, white 34deg 38deg,
            #ffc107 38deg 70deg, white 70deg 74deg,
            #fd7e14 74deg 106deg, white 106deg 110deg,
            #e74c3c 110deg 142deg, white 142deg 146deg,
            #9b59b6 146deg 180deg, transparent 180deg 360deg
          );"></div>
        <div style="position: absolute; top: 45px; left: 45px; width: 170px; height: 170px; border-radius: 50%; background: white;"></div>
        <div style="position: absolute; bottom: -10px; left: 120px; width: 20px; height: 110px; transform-origin: bottom center; transform: rotate(${angle}deg); transition: transform 1s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1); z-index: 10; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;">
            <div style="width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 6px solid transparent; border-right: 6px solid transparent; border-bottom: 75px solid #333333;"></div>
            <div style="width: 20px; height: 20px; background: #333333; border-radius: 50%; margin-top: -6px;"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 15px;">
        <span style="font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 900; color: ${textColor};">${levelText}</span><br>
        <span style="font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: bold; color: #333;">${val}</span> <span style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #666;">ca</span>
      </div>
      <p style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: transparent; margin-top: 10px;">.</p> 
    </div>
  `;
}
```

```{ojs}
// 👉 4. GAUGE ĐÁNH GIÁ MỨC ĐỘ NẶNG (4 MỨC)
sev_gauge = {
  let val = d3.sum(data_sxh.filter(d => d.Year === sys_max_yr && d.Week === sys_max_wk && d.NhomDieuTri === "Nội trú"), d => d.SoCa) || 0;
  let current_thr = data_severity.find(d => d.Disease === "Sốt xuất huyết" && Number(d.Week) === sys_max_wk) || {Limit_Low: 0, Limit_Mod: 0, Limit_High: 0};

  let level = 1; let levelText = "DƯỚI NGƯỠNG"; let textColor = "#2ecc71"; // Xanh lá

  if (current_thr.Limit_Low > 0) {
     if (val >= current_thr.Limit_High) { level = 4; levelText = "RẤT CAO"; textColor = "#e74c3c"; } // Đỏ
     else if (val >= current_thr.Limit_Mod) { level = 3; levelText = "CAO"; textColor = "#fd7e14"; } // Cam
     else if (val >= current_thr.Limit_Low) { level = 2; levelText = "VỪA"; textColor = "#ffc107"; } // Vàng
  }

  let angle = (level * 45) - 112.5;

  return html`
    <div style="width: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative;">
      <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #005d88; margin-bottom: 25px;">Đánh giá mức độ nặng</div>
      <div style="position: relative; width: 260px; height: 130px; overflow: hidden;">
        <div style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 260px; height: 260px; border-radius: 50%;
          background: conic-gradient(from 270deg, 
            #2ecc71 0deg 43deg, white 43deg 47deg,
            #ffc107 47deg 88deg, white 88deg 92deg,
            #fd7e14 92deg 133deg, white 133deg 137deg,
            #e74c3c 137deg 180deg, transparent 180deg 360deg
          );"></div>
        <div style="position: absolute; top: 45px; left: 45px; width: 170px; height: 170px; border-radius: 50%; background: white;"></div>
        <div style="position: absolute; bottom: -10px; left: 120px; width: 20px; height: 110px; transform-origin: bottom center; transform: rotate(${angle}deg); transition: transform 1s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1); z-index: 10; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;">
            <div style="width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 6px solid transparent; border-right: 6px solid transparent; border-bottom: 75px solid #333333;"></div>
            <div style="width: 20px; height: 20px; background: #333333; border-radius: 50%; margin-top: -6px;"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 15px;">
        <span style="font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 900; color: ${textColor};">${levelText}</span><br>
        <span style="font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: bold; color: #333;">${val}</span> <span style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #666;">ca nội trú</span>
      </div>
      <p style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #999; margin-top: 10px; font-style: italic;">*PISA - WHO</p>
    </div>
  `;
}
```
